title: An Act respecting the regulation of the Profession of Chiropody (Chiropody Act, 1991)
why: bills_master had 'An Act to revive Lordina Limited'; the Hansard heading for Bill 45 on 1991-04-02 is CHIROPODY ACT, 1991, and Bill 45 sits in the alphabetical run of 1991 health profession bills (43 RHPA ... 64 Respiratory Therapy)
